summary.en: Noblewoman of Ravenna, daughter of Guido da Polenta, married for political reasons into the Malatesta family, lords of Rimini. Dante's poem is the earliest surviving record of her; later knowledge comes largely from his commentators.

en: Daughter of Guido I da Polenta, lord of Ravenna
Her nephew Guido Novello da Polenta later hosted Dante in Ravenna
